content:
Maya Singh: Quick sync — AtlasHealth POC cutover plan updated. Posting current timeline and open deps. Need owners for network whitelists, evals, and canary traffic policy.

Jonathan Park: Thanks Maya. I can own SE side for acceptance criteria + customer dry run.

Alex Ruiz: I’ll take infra ownership (provisioning, scheduler). Samir can you handle the VPC peering + firewall rules?

Samir Patel: Yup — can do VPC peering. Need the target CIDR and a point of contact on Atlas side. cc @Jonathan Park for contact.

Leah Chen: I’ll run the integration tests and the eval prompt suite. Can someone add the eval dataset to the shared S3 bucket?

Maya Singh: @Samir: Atlas contact is amanda@atlashealth.com, CIDR 10.48.0.0/16. @Leah: putting dataset in s3://redwood-poc/atlashealth/evals by EOD today.

Jonathan Park: Acceptance criteria (short): 1) baseline latency < 220ms p50 for 1k QPS sim, 2) embeddings match sample vectors within threshold, 3) regression-free on 5 canonical prompts. Will post a formal doc later.

Alex Ruiz: Cutover window proposal: 2026-04-12 22:00-02:00 UTC. Plan: provision, run smoke tests, enable canary (5% traffic), monitor 30m, then ramp.

Samir Patel: Firewall rules needed: allow egress to Atlas IPs x.x.x.x/32 on port 443, and allow inbound health checks from their health IP pool. I’ll request firewall exception ticket.

Leah Chen: Test matrix quick note:
```
- smoke: auth + basic prompt gen
- perf: 1k QPS sim (Locust)
- evals: 50 prompt regression set
- security: secrets rotation + KMS access check
```
I’ll attach the Locust scenario after lunch.

Maya Singh: Outstanding deps list (short):
- Network whitelisting (owner: Samir)
- Eval dataset upload (owner: Maya)
- Canary routing policy + traffic split (owner: Alex)
- SE dry run schedule with Atlas (owner: Jonathan)
- Security review signoff (owner: Security)

sec-bot: Security review required: pre-cutover checklist pending. Please file ticket in security-triage with tag `atlas-poc`.

Jonathan Park: Suggest scheduling a dry run w/ Atlas on 2026-04-09 15:00 UTC — can we lock that?

Alex Ruiz: Works for infra. Samir, any blackout windows from network side that week?

Samir Patel: No blackout. Will aim to complete VPC peering + firewall rules by 2026-04-08. Opening the ticket now.

Leah Chen: Small request — can we add a short rollback plan in the playbook? Just a one-liner for ops: disable canary, failover to hosted model variant, rollback infra changes if needed.

Maya Singh: Agreed. I’ll add rollback steps to the cutover doc. Final ask: please react with :thumbsup: on this thread once your ownership is confirmed.

Alex Ruiz: :thumbsup:
Jonathan Park: :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: :thumbsup:
Leah Chen: :thumbsup:
Maya Singh: Thanks all — I’ll ping again after security ticket is created.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline check — all required CI jobs green for branch `atlas/poc-cutover` (build, integration-tests, docs).
